flows.title: Create an event type
steps: Select the + Create button and choose an event type.
Customize the event's details in the event editor on the right. Select More options for further settings.

flows.title: Copy a scheduling link
steps: Find the event type to share and hover over it to see more options.
Choose Copy link to copy the standard booking link to paste anywhere.

flows.title: Create an availability schedule
steps: Go to Scheduling, then select Manage availability.
Open the Schedule dropdown menu and select + Create schedule.
Name the new schedule and select Create.
In List view, under Weekly hours, select + to add each day to be available, then set the start and end times for each time block.
